title: Remember a Long Number
summary: Group things into small chunks before memorising them.

steps.title: The puzzle
sentences: Try to remember this number after one look: 4 9 2 7 1 8 3 5.
points: Try to remember this number after one look: 4 9 2 7 1 8 3 5.

steps.title: How to think about it
sentences: Eight single digits are hard to hold.
Groups are easier to remember than single items.
points: Eight single digits are hard to hold.

steps.title: The method: Chunking
sentences: Link each chunk to something familiar, like an age or a house number.
Say the chunks aloud in rhythm.

steps.title: The answer
sentences: Four chunks of two digits are easier than eight single digits.
Phone numbers are written in groups for this reason.
Chunking works for words, dates and lists too.
points: Four chunks of two digits are easier than eight single digits.
